verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repository (github.com/paypal/agent-toolkit) hosts the Agent Toolkit component, so some of the product's source is readable. The evidence never states an open license, and the core hosted services (Store Sync, Agent Ready, the cart API, the remote MCP server) show no public source. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open-source license, public source for the hosted agentic-commerce services, independent corroboration of licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The PayPal Agent Toolkit enables popular agent frameworks including OpenAI's Agent SDK, LangChain, Vercel's AI SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate with PayPal APIs through function calling.
create_order: Create an order in PayPal system based on provided details
